high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a dark background, leaning slightly against a textured wall. The individual is wearing an elegant black dress with intricate embellishments. The dress has a deep V-neckline adorned with sparkling details that create a decorative border around the neckline and waist area. The fabric appears to be form-fitting, accentuating the figure, and there is a high slit on one side of the dress, revealing a portion of the leg. The person's hair is styled in loose waves, cascading over their shoulders.
